title: Rainy Museum Corridor
description: A dimly lit museum hall with a large surreal painting dominating the right wall, depicting a long flooded hallway with red emergency lights and an exit sign. Rain pours through a broken skylight onto the wet floor where puddles reflect the crimson glow, while a wooden desk in the foreground holds a lit green banker's lamp, a steaming cup, and a vintage radio.
prompt: A moody cinematic scene inside a dark abandoned museum gallery at night. Rain falls heavily through a broken skylight onto the wet floor creating reflective puddles. On the right wall hangs a massive surreal painting showing an endless flooded green hallway with glowing red exit signs and emergency lights. In the left foreground, a wooden desk holds a glowing green banker's lamp, steaming coffee cup, and old radio. Atmospheric lighting, eerie and melancholic mood, highly detailed digital painting.
